point_in_time_design.signal_availability: At close t use only versions published before that market's signal cutoff. After-close announcement first affects the next tradable session. If only a date is known, apply a conservative next-session lag and mark estimated. Never attach later updates retroactively.
point_in_time_design.cash_accounting: Entitlement is determined from shares held before actual ex date; recognize receivable then cash only on pay date, with route-specific withholding, FX spread, fees and share count. Track unsettled receivable at period end.
point_in_time_design.ordinary_baseline: For semiannual issuers use complete latest known fiscal-year ordinary interim+final, excluding special, return of capital and buybacks. Keep board-proposed separate from approved; latest comparable-period cut triggers review and downward scenarios, not an automatic buy on higher yield. Do not annualize one semiannual installment by2.
point_in_time_design.us_run_rate: For stable ordinary monthly/quarterly schedule latest declared regular DPS*12/*4 may be shown as INDICATED annual amount; maintain separately from completed fiscal-year DPS and TTM cash received. Future installments are not guaranteed.
point_in_time_design.currency: DPS currency and price currency must match. For historical signal use only FX known then; actual cash uses issuer/depositary conversion and payment-date mechanics. A HKD/CNY settlement choice is not two dividends. Bank of China source demonstrates per10 shares and an announced FX conversion.
point_in_time_design.ads: All18 listed instruments here are ordinary/common shares (A,H orUS common), not ADR/ADS. For any expansion to ADRs require depositary primary source for underlying-shares-per-ADS and effective date; multiply underlying DPS by that ratio, convert currency, subtract depositary fees and withholding. Never mix a per-H-share dividend with per-ADS price.
point_in_time_design.specials_and_splits: Store specials separately and exclude them from recurring yield. A regular dividend plus special in same notice creates two components. Split-adjust old DPS only on a consistent per-share basis with comparable prices; retain original cash units. Include spin-offs/mergers/name changes in total-return accounting.
point_in_time_design.backtest_gate: No profitability conclusion until complete PIT dividends, corporate actions, historical universe including failures/delistings, tradable bars, tax/FX/fees and next-session execution are reconstructed. Current yields must never be backfilled into2023-2026.

telecom.why_different: Recurring subscriptions help cash generation, while capex, spectrum and leases consume cash; similar headline yield can conceal different financing burdens.

bank.why_different: Cash-flow-statement FCF is not a suitable bank coverage gate; loss absorption and regulatory capital constrain distributions.
checks: profit after preferred/AT1 claims versus common dividend

upstream_oil.why_different: Distributions depend on oil/gas prices and sustaining production; low reported payout can coexist with a falling dividend.
checks: oil/gas downside price FCF after sustaining capex

integrated_oil.why_different: Integration diversifies segments but upstream/refining margins still cycle; a strong quarter cannot define sustainable annual income.

refining_chemicals.why_different: Refining and chemical spreads can weaken independently of upstream prices; buybacks are not cash income to holders.
known_risk_examples: two consecutive annual ordinary DPS cuts

coal_power_logistics.why_different: Coal price, long-term contracted volumes, power margins and transport integration affect recurring cash; interim introduction changes cash calendar.

hydropower.why_different: Hydrology, regulated tariffs and acquisition debt matter more than a generic payout cutoff.

reit.why_different: Depreciation depresses GAAP profit; AFFO with reconciliation is a better recurring cash starting point, while refinancing and tenant risk remain material.
checks: tax character including return of capital

tobacco.why_different: High cash margins coexist with structural volume decline and regulation; high yield requires downside coverage rather than a universal safe-yield label.

healthcare.why_different: Lower current yield may buy greater business diversification; patents, litigation and reinvestment still constrain coverage.

rule_proposals.ordinary_sustainable_dividend: D_base = complete known ordinary fiscal DPS, with specials excluded; D_stress = D_base*(1-cut_scenario). Use latest declared US run rate as a separate indicator. Base must be reduced/reviewed after a known cut, not frozen to historical high.
rule_proposals.buy_rule: After eligibility passes, compare Y_base=D_base/P and Y_stress=D_stress/P with a predeclared group/issuer hurdle; stage research entries only when both income valuation and price provide margin. A rising yield caused by a cut is not an eligibility pass.
rule_proposals.reduce_rule: When price rises so normalized yield falls below the group's lower exit threshold, stage reductions; a verified dividend cut or coverage failure is a separate fundamental review trigger even if price fell.

threshold_research_grid.interpretation: Test group-specific combinations and known-at-time local currency bond yield spreads; no common6.5% threshold is accepted acrossbanks/oil/REITs/tobacco.

rule_proposals.portfolio: Separate dividend strategy cash, inventory and attribution from price-only strategy; cap economic issuer and sector exposure and stage sizes with finite cash, board lots and taxes. Cross-listings count as one issuer risk.
rule_proposals.comparison_design: Compare dividend-rule portfolio against buy-and-hold of same eligible universe, cash/bond baseline and price-only rule on a separately chosen volatile universe. Record total return and income separately; do not call price-only adjusted-price results dividend-strategy alpha.
